title: Aftercare
line: Astrology, tarot, and a journal, as an Expo app, a Netlify web app, and an Astro site. The plan was a Dawn profile.

title: Carrie
line: Carrie's suite: PageMatch for books, PawCert for pets, and a portal. Books were filed for Dawn. Pets were filed for Bagel. The repo was still up.

title: CRM
line: A private contacts and deal board for Artometrics. The plan was to fold it into Dawn and keep the Firebase project.

title: Fernbound
line: A canvas game meant to become a Dawn hunt for nearby spirits. No GitHub repo. The box tree is the source.

title: KSM dashboard
line: A stub host with placeholder text and a local git history of three commits. This site already covered it.

title: Lineage
line: A browser battle for Cannae, Austerlitz, and Waterloo. The archive says merge it into Pantheon and keep the repo.

title: Loom
line: A YouTube cut board: script, captions, and a transcriber. It does not download YouTube. The host was deleted after the zip.

title: Magazine mockup
line: An Artometrics magazine front end on its own host. The mockup was retired. artometrics.com stayed.

title: Mia Maps
line: A Craigslist rental hunter for Mia. The hourly scrape was still running when the archive was packed.

title: Mint
line: A private image and short-video generator. The voice note called it MIT. No GitHub repo was found.

title: Newsletter
line: The Artometrics letter: consent, a markdown composer, and batch send. The host was deleted. The note says the box source was kept for Dawn.

title: Priority
line: The Priority site: a small Rainfall Health command center. Static files, no Firestore, deleted with the Rainfall removal.

title: Recipes
line: Style Recipes, a style board. The archive note says it was already inside Dawn, and that it is not a food site.

title: Relay
line: One Expo desk for a podcast host, a social queue, and a releases shelf. Archived as a whole product. The host was deleted.

title: Skins
line: A magazine skins and style board. The live title was Artometrics, magazine skins and style board. No GitHub repo.

title: Nightlight and the other small games
line: Nightlight, Questroad, Cardinal Quest, Knightmare, and the Godot toys. Archived 13 Nov 2026, then the repos and hosts were deleted.

title: Storefront
line: A pay-once counter for Artometrics editions, meant to stand in for Gumroad. The Firebase project was deleted after the zip.

title: Style Lab
line: A gallery for picking an Artometrics look, with favorites stored in the browser. The host was deleted after a Firestore dump of three user docs.

title: Vault
line: A research shelf and a photo shelf. Heavier than the CRM, and left as a later Dawn library or an archive.

title: Webfall
line: A Rainfall Health URL that was already Site Not Found. No repo in Artometrics or kylesmcauliffe. The archive is a 404 mirror.
